audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Imputed classifications described as observed practices; Survey precision heuristic used to infer statistical power; Prior Internet training equated with live tool access.
limitations: P2 — Survey precision heuristic used to infer statistical power — Counterevidence: The source says 'By this standard' and immediately recommends effect-specific power analysis. Its conditional precision interpretation must be preserved.

P3 — Prior Internet training equated with live tool access — Counterevidence: Appendix D proposes that the asymmetric comparison can be fair. The analytic example establishes distinct information access, not unfairness; no universal fairness theorem is asserted.
